title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II. A gripping portrait of the man who changed the world forever.

title: Poor Things
overview: The incredible tale about the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

title: Killers of the Flower Moon
overview: Members of the Osage Nation are murdered under mysterious circumstances in the 1920s, sparking a major F.B.I. investigation involving J. Edgar Hoover.

title: Alien: Romulus
overview: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

title: Inside Out 2
overview: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions. Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Disgust are pushed to make room for Anxiety.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
overview: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

title: The Wild Robot
overview: After a shipwreck, robot Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island and must adapt to the harsh environment, raising a gosling she has adopted as her own.

title: Wicked
overview: The story of Elphaba, a young woman misunderstood because of her unusual green skin, and Glinda, a popular aristocrat, as they forge an unlikely friendship in the Land of Oz.

title: Godzilla x Kong
overview: The epic battle continues as Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world, challenging their very existence and our own.

title: Twisters
overview: Kate Cooper, a former storm chaser haunted by a devastating encounter with a tornado, is lured back to the open plains of Oklahoma by her friend Javi to test a new storm-tracking system.

title: A Quiet Place: Day One
overview: Experience the day the world went quiet. Follow a woman's journey of survival as New York City is invaded by creatures that hunt by sound.
